messages:
june_support: customer reports intermittent 500s and huge tail latency on Dedicated EU cluster for model inference. they provided two request ids: rw-req-20260305-9a7b and rw-req-20260305-9a8c. asking for repro bundle + pod/node logs so we can trace GPU metrics.
samir_oncall: thanks june. can you confirm exact time windows and which tenant? also we need a curl repro if possible, plus the `x-rw-request-id` header values. :eyes:
june_support: tenant is acme-inc, windows: 2026-03-05 15:12:20Z - 15:14:00Z. attached are the two request ids above. no reproducible curl yet, customer says it happens randomly under load.
maya_infra: ok i'll start a debug bundle request for the node set. can you run a curl that reproduces the error and include `-H \"x-rw-request-id: <id>\"` so we can match traces? if not, i'll grab pod logs + kube events and node dmesg around the timestamps.
leo_gpu_sre: also want `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=utilization.gpu,utilization.memory,temperature.gpu --format=csv -l 1` for the window if we can get it. MIG config? any GPU reset events? may need `dmesg | tail -n 200` and `journalctl -u kubelet --since \"2026-03-05 15:00:00\" --until \"2026-03-05 15:30:00\"`.
june_support: customer gave us a short curl they used for a single request that returned 500. here's sanitized version they ran locally:

```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\" \
  -H \"x-rw-request-id: rw-req-20260305-9a7b\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-large","prompt":"short test", "max_tokens":32}'
```

it returned HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error for them.
samir_oncall: perfect, that matches. june, can you ask them to run that with `--trace-ascii trace.log` and attach the trace? in parallel i'll request pod logs: `kubectl -n dedicated-tenant-acme logs -l app=inference --since=20m --tail=500` and kube events. will also pull request traces matching `rw-req-20260305-9a7b` from the API gateway.
maya_infra: debug-bot initiated: diag-bot created bundle id db-87321 and uploaded to s3://redwood-debug/acme/db-87321.zip — includes node snapshots, kube-state, containerd logs, and kernel dmesg sampling. :robot_face:
leo_gpu_sre: grabbing GPU exporter metrics from prometheus for those node names. will extract `nvidia_gpu_duty_cycle`, `nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes`, `node_cpu_seconds_total` around the window. also checking for transient ECC errors.
june_support: customer attached the trace log and says they saw a long pause before the 500, about ~6s, then immediate 500. attaching the trace content snippet.

```
=> Send header, 420 bytes (0x1a4)
< HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error
< content-type: application/json
< x-rw-request-id: rw-req-20260305-9a7b

{"error":"runtime: inference node timeout while waiting for gpu scheduler"}
```

samir_oncall: interesting, gateway passed the req id back. leo, any signs of GPU scheduling stalls in exporter? maya, did the node debug bundle show OOM or throttling?
leo_gpu_sre: exporter shows GPU util dropped to ~0 for ~5s right before the error on node gpu-45. memory stayed allocated. no ECC or driver faults, but there are bursts of high PCIe retransmits in the NIC metrics around the same time. need to correlate with `nvidia-smi` logs.
maya_infra: node bundle shows kubelet restarted one inference pod at 15:12:58 (container restart count +1). kube events show `BackOff` for that pod earlier, and CRI errors `failed to update container status: context deadline exceeded` around 15:12:56.
june_support: customer is ok granting a temporary support SSH key to fetch `nvidia-smi` history and `journalctl` live logs. they want to know exactly what you need us to run if they allow access.
samir_oncall: if they can SSH, run:

```
sudo journalctl -u kubelet --since "2026-03-05 15:05:00" --until "2026-03-05 15:20:00" > /tmp/kubelet-window.log
sudo dmesg --ctime | sed -n '1,200p' > /tmp/dmesg-window.log
sudo nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps=pid,used_memory,process_name --format=csv -lms 1000 > /tmp/nvidia-smi-sample.log &
# run for ~2 minutes during repro window
```

and tar those into the debug bundle path `db-87321/extra/` and re-upload.
leo_gpu_sre: also run `ethtool -S eth0 > /tmp/eth0-stats.log` and `sudo cat /proc/interrupts | grep nvidia` so we can see PCIe/NIC interrupts timing.
june_support: will ask them. also noted they are on Dedicated EU with reserved capacity pool `eu-dedicated-3`, pod names start with `acme-inf-`. i requested an S3 path to upload extra files and they confirmed they added keys for support-upload. :white_check_mark:
maya_infra: once they upload, i'll re-run the bundle ingestion to attach to the support ticket and kick off the automated trace correlation job to join gateway traces with node logs.

samir_oncall: plan:
- get customer to run the curl with `--trace-ascii`
- ask them to grant temporary SSH or upload `/tmp/nvidia-smi-sample.log`, `/tmp/kubelet-window.log`, `/tmp/dmesg-window.log`, `eth0-stats.log`
- we correlate with gateway traces for rw-req-20260305-9a7b and rw-req-20260305-9a8c
- if we see kernel-level stalls, escalate to infra-sre and plan a maintenance window for deeper inspects.

june_support: sending steps and the exact commands now. i'll post when they upload. thanks all :pray:
diag-bot: bundle db-87321 updated: extra files attached by customer at s3://redwood-debug/acme/db-87321/extra/ (file list: nvidia-smi-sample.log, kubelet-window.log, dmesg-window.log, eth0-stats.log). correlation job queued.
samir_oncall: received the upload, starting correlation. i'll post findings in-thread once correlation completes. :mag:
june_support: :thumbsup:
